regions.today: A mix of cloud and some sunny spells this evening along with a little rain or drizzle, gradually clearing southeastwards. Light, occasionally moderate westerly breezes, veering northwesterly.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with clear spells. Light variable breezes or near calm conditions will allow some mist and fog patches to develop. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 12 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Dry with sunny spells, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 18 to 24 degrees with a light southerly or variable breeze.
